title: xolanthes racemosa
intro: Xolanthes racemosa, commonly known as the Desert Marigold, is a perennial wildflower native to the Southwestern United States. This plant is valued for its bright yellow and orange flowers, and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Xolanthes racemosa include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve immune function, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating colds, fever, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Xolanthes racemosa include sesquiterpenoids and phenolic compounds, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
